library(gt) library(dplyr) logo_path <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jrycw/posit-gt-2024/master/logo/" logo_pngs <- c("bmw", "hyundai", "kia", "smart", "vinfast", "xpeng") testing_groups <- list( adult = c("Frontal Impact", "Lateral Impact", "Rear Impact", "Rescue and Extrication"), child = c("Crash Test Performance", "Safety Features", "CRS Installation Check"), vru = c("VRU Impact Protection", "VRU Impact Mitigation"), assist = c("Speed Assistance", "Occupant Status Monitoring", "Lane Support", "AEB Car-to-Car") ) group_names <- names(testing_groups) testing_columns <- unlist(testing_groups, use.names = FALSE) testing_columns_with_rank <- unlist(lapply(group_names, \(g) c(testing_groups[[g]], g))) df <- read.csv("../data/contest/euroncap_2023.csv", check.names = FALSE, colClasses = c(Stars = "character")) for (g in group_names) df[[g]] <- rowSums(df[testing_groups[[g]]]) df <- df |> mutate( Model = paste0("[", Model, "](", Url, ")"), Make = paste0(tolower(Make), ifelse(tolower(Make) %in% logo_pngs, ".png", ".jpg")), Stars = paste0(Stars, "⭐") ) |> mutate(across(all_of(group_names), \(x) min_rank(desc(x)))) |> mutate(Rank = min_rank(rowMeans(pick(all_of(group_names))))) |> arrange(desc(Class), Rank, adult, child, vru, assist) |> select(Class, Model, Make, Stars, Rank, all_of(testing_columns_with_rank)) domain_nominal_max <- c( "Frontal Impact" = 16, "Lateral Impact" = 16, "Rear Impact" = 4, "Rescue and Extrication" = 4, "Crash Test Performance" = 24, "Safety Features" = 13, "CRS Installation Check" = 12, "VRU Impact Protection" = 36, "VRU Impact Mitigation" = 27, "Speed Assistance" = 3, "Occupant Status Monitoring" = 3, "Lane Support" = 3, "AEB Car-to-Car" = 9 ) top_scores <- c(adult = 40, child = 49, vru = 63, assist = 18) short_names <- c( "Frontal
Impact", "Lateral
Impact", "Rear
Impact", "Rescue&
Extrication", "Crash
Test", "Safety
Features", "CRS
Installation
Check", "Impact 
Protection ", "Impact 
Mitigation ", "Speed
Assistance", "Occupant
Status
Monitoring", "Lane
Support", "AEB C2C3" ) group_of <- rep(group_names, lengths(testing_groups)) testing_labels <- setNames( lapply(seq_along(testing_columns), \(i) html(paste0( short_names[i], "
(", domain_nominal_max[[testing_columns[i]]], "/", top_scores[[group_of[i]]], ")" ))), testing_columns ) srank_labels <- setNames(rep(list(html("SRank2")), 4), group_names) a_html <- function(text, url) html(paste0('', text, "")) explained <- "https://www.euroncap.com/en/car-safety/the-ratings-explained/" spanners <- list( adult = a_html("Adult Occupant", paste0(explained, "adult-occupant-protection/")), child = a_html("Child Occupant", paste0(explained, "child-occupant-protection/")), vru = a_html("Vulnerable Road Users", paste0(explained, "vulnerable-road-user-vru-protection/")), assist = a_html("Safety Assist", paste0(explained, "safety-assist/")) ) gtbl <- df |> gt(groupname_col = "Class", rowname_col = "Model") |> fmt_image(Make, path = logo_path) |> fmt_number(all_of(testing_columns), decimals = 1) |> fmt_markdown(Model) |> cols_width(all_of(testing_columns) ~ px(60), all_of(group_names) ~ px(30)) |> cols_align("center", c(Make, Stars)) |> cols_align("right", c(Rank, all_of(group_names))) |> cols_label(.list = c(list(Rank = html("Rank1")), testing_labels, srank_labels)) |> tab_header( title = html('

Euro NCAP SAFETY RATINGS - 2023

'), subtitle = html("

The more stars, the better.

") ) |> tab_spanner(a_html("Rating", explained), c(Stars, Rank), id = "rating") for (g in group_names) { gtbl <- gtbl |> tab_spanner(spanners[[g]], all_of(c(testing_groups[[g]], g)), id = paste0("spanner_", g)) } gtbl |> tab_stubhead(html('

')) |> tab_options( stub.background.color = "#D4E6A8", table.background.color = "#F5F5F5", heading.align = "left", heading.subtitle.font.size = "16px", heading.subtitle.font.weight = "bold", column_labels.font.size = "14px", column_labels.background.color = "#D4E6A8", row_group.font.size = "18px", row_group.font.weight = "bold", row_group.background.color = "#BFE2A7" ) |> opt_table_font(stack = "industrial") |> tab_style(cell_fill(color = "#F4FAF1"), cells_body()) |> tab_style(cell_fill(color = "#C0DA80"), cells_body(columns = Stars, rows = Stars == "5⭐")) |> data_color( columns = c(Rank, all_of(group_names)), palette = c("#E7CE91", "#F2E4C0", "#F5EFE7"), domain = c(1, nrow(df)) ) |> tab_source_note(html("1 Rank is derived from the rank of the averaged ranks across the four categories.")) |> tab_source_note(html("2 SRank refers to ranking by the sum of each category.")) |> tab_source_note(html("3 AEB C2C stands for AEB Car-to-Car.")) |> tab_source_note(html(paste( 'Source: Euro NCAP', 'Table: Jerry Wu', 'Repo: posit-gt-2024', sep = " | " )))
